fn factorial(n: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (n <= 1) then 1 else (n * factorial((n - 1)))))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (factorial(0) == 1)
  example (factorial(2) == 2)
{
  if (n <= 1) then 1 else (n * factorial((n - 1)))
}

fn sum_range(n: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (n == 0) then 0 else (n + sum_range((n - 1)))))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (sum_range(0) == 0)
  example (sum_range(1) == 1)
{
  if (n == 0) then 0 else (n + sum_range((n - 1)))
}

fn f(n: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires (n >= 0)
  ensures (len(result) == n)
  ensures forall i in 0..n: if (((i + 1) % 2) == 0) then (result[i] == factorial((i + 1))) else (result[i] == sum_range((i + 1)))
  ensures forall x in result: (x >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (f(0) == [])
{
  []
}
